name: Turbo Twirly
description:
When the character to which this is attached is switched out: Consume 1 Nightsoul point, and summon 1 Turbo Twirly: Let It Rip.
Technique: Twirly Twirly Bam Bam
(A character can only equip 1 Technique at a time)
When the attached character has 0 Nightsoul points, discard this card. When this card is discarded, the attached character's Nightsoul's Blessing ends.
